name: Hiding Inside
source:
A typical day, a familiar routine – until the mist parted and revealed Marika, staring into the lake, oddly preoccupied. She noticed you, her shock quickly replaced by a tense urgency.

[From [url=https://tunkl0.itch.io/hiding-inside]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
典型的一天，熟悉的例行公事——直到薄雾散去，露出玛丽卡，她凝视着湖水，神情奇怪地全神贯注。她注意到了你，她的震惊很快就被紧张的紧迫感所取代。

[来自[url=https://tunkl0.itch.io/hiding-inside]Itch.io[/url]]
